answer-help: Answers are case-insensitive. Spaces at the start, end, or within the answer are ignored, as are accents.
error-too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
admin.help: Add one or more questions. Users must give a valid answer to every question shown to register.
admin.rotation-help: When disabled, the first questions are shown in the configured order.
admin.question-count-help: Leave blank to show all available questions.
admin.question: Question
admin.honeypot-help: Adds an invisible field that bots tend to fill in.
admin.token-help: Randomizes field names and rejects expired or tampered forms.
admin.autocomplete-help: Adds autocomplete=off and spellcheck=false to the answer fields.
